applicability: The notes listing behind GET /api/notes/list (list_notes and its walk helpers in mcp/src/agents_remember/serving/notes.py) over one series master's tasks/<repo>/<master>/notes/ root.
conditions: A note can grow in place, which changes its size without changing any directory mtime.

Family examination: no joint obligation is supported. Basis: This records a rejected design (negative knowledge) whose protective effect is already the no-listing-state member; making it a second member would count one reason twice.
exclusions: Caches keyed on each file's own metadata, which this decision does not examine.
statement: The notes listing is not cached by directory mtimes because a note growing in place changes its size without changing any directory mtime, which would serve stale sizes and break live refresh.
